protocol.scope: Relation-pair holdout within known graphs; not unseen-graph transfer.
protocol.oracle: Independent Python queue-based BFS with explicit self-loops.
protocol.dense_family: Random DAG with edge probability 0.45 plus explicit self-loops.
protocol.cyclic_family: Two disjoint directed cycles plus explicit self-loops.
protocol.failure_policy: Preserve every predeclared case, including errors and budget exhaustion.

cases.scope: Unseen relation pairs within the same known graph; not unseen-graph transfer.
